sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: an open-source AI coding agent / harness with IDE, CLI, and SDK applications on one agent core (`claim-cline-sf-identity`, `claim-cline-sf-what-it-is`, `claim-cline-sf-primary-type`)
- What it is not: a simple autocomplete extension (`claim-cline-sf-what-it-is-not-autocomplete`). Kanban is a related first-party app on the same core and is not merged into this project id (`claim-cline-sf-what-it-is-not-kanban-id`). ClinePass is optional (`claim-cline-sf-not-for`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-cline-sf-primary-type`)
- Secondary role: `ide` (`claim-cline-sf-secondary-role-ide`)
- Agent-loop owner: Cline SDK / ClineCore; hub coordinates, spokes execute (`claim-cline-sf-agent-loop-owner`)
- Architecture: local hub-spoke daemon with backend modes `auto`, `hub`, `remote`, and `local`; default hub `127.0.0.1:25463` (`claim-cline-sf-architecture`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-cline-vscode-extension`, `surface-cline-jetbrains-plugin`, `surface-cline-cli`, `surface-cline-acp`, `surface-cline-sdk`, `surface-cline-http-api`, `surface-cline-desktop`, `surface-cline-telegram`, `surface-cline-slack`, `surface-cline-discord`, `surface-cline-gchat`, `surface-cline-whatsapp`, `surface-cline-linear`
- Execution location: same-device by default (`claim-cline-sf-execution-local`). Optional remote hub endpoint; first-party hosted cloud host unknown (`claim-cline-sf-execution-remote-hub`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: Cline usage-billing, optional ClinePass, or BYOK/local (`claim-cline-sf-model-strategy`)
- Auth strategy: Google/GitHub/email OAuth for Cline providers; provider API keys for BYOK; no key for local Ollama/LM Studio; `cline auth` for CLI (`claim-cline-sf-auth-strategy`)
- Provider support: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Bedrock, Azure, Vertex, Cerebras, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (`claim-cline-sf-provider-support`)
- Local models: Ollama, LM Studio, Atomic Chat (`claim-cline-sf-local-models`)
- Subscription reuse: Claude Max/Pro via Claude CLI (`claim-cline-sf-reuses-auth-claude`, `claim-cline-sf-wraps-cli-claude-code`); OpenAI Codex OAuth (`claim-cline-sf-reuses-auth-codex`)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: selective codebase reads (`claim-cline-sf-context-behavior`); Plan/Act history carries over (`claim-cline-sf-context-plan-act`); numeric default window unknown
- Memory: `.clinerules`, skills, and optional Memory Bank markdown; Memory Bank is a methodology, not a separate memory product (`claim-cline-sf-memory`)
- Compaction: Auto Compact summarization near the limit, with truncation fallback on some models (`claim-cline-sf-compaction`)
- Session behavior: hub-persisted sessions with multi-client attach (`claim-cline-sf-session-behavior`); shadow-git checkpoints after each tool use (`claim-cline-sf-session-checkpoints`)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: ClineCore built-ins `bash`, `editor`, `read_files`, `apply_patch`, `search`, `fetch_web`, `ask_question`, plus MCP (`claim-cline-sf-tools`). Marketplace still describes a headless browser computer-use path (`claim-cline-sf-tools-browser-marketplace`)
- Extensions: plugins on SDK/CLI/Kanban; docs say not on VS Code or JetBrains for now (`claim-cline-sf-extensions`). CHANGELOG 4.0.0 describes a VS Code Customize marketplace (`claim-cline-sf-extensions-vscode-marketplace`)
- MCP: client for local STDIO and remote HTTP/SSE (`claim-cline-sf-mcp`)
- Skills: on-demand `SKILL.md` (`claim-cline-sf-skills`)
- Hooks: plugin and file-based lifecycle hooks (`claim-cline-sf-hooks`)
- APIs: `@cline/sdk` (`claim-cline-sf-api`), `cline --acp` (`claim-cline-sf-api-acp`), and an OpenAI-compatible Cline HTTP API (`claim-cline-sf-api-http`)

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: Plan/Act dual mode with optional deep-planning (`claim-cline-sf-orchestration`). CLI/SDK/Kanban coordinator teams; not VS Code or JetBrains for now (`claim-cline-sf-orchestration-teams`)
- Parallelism: parallel read-only subagents (`claim-cline-sf-parallelism`). CHANGELOG 4.0.0 said VS Code subagents were temporarily disabled (`claim-cline-sf-parallelism-4-0-disable`)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: optional `CLINE_SANDBOX`; default isolation unknown (`claim-cline-sf-isolation`)
- Permissions: per-category Auto Approve gates (`claim-cline-sf-permissions`). `CLINE_COMMAND_PERMISSIONS` allow/deny policy (`claim-cline-sf-permissions-command-policy`). CLI `--auto-approve` defaults to true (`claim-cline-sf-permissions-cli-default`); ACP defaults to false (`claim-cline-sf-permissions-acp-default`). YOLO Mode is still documented (`claim-cline-sf-permissions-yolo-docs`) and was removed as a cosmetic toggle in 4.1.8 (`claim-cline-sf-permissions-yolo-removed`)
- Security: enterprise SSO/RBAC/remote config/OpenTelemetry; local client-side execution claim (`claim-cline-sf-security`). Marketplace enterprise copy separately lists SAML/OIDC, audit trails, VPC/private link, and self-hosted or on-prem (`claim-cline-sf-security-marketplace`)
- Data path: FAQ says BYOK goes direct to the provider and Cline credits pass through Cline infrastructure with no training (`claim-cline-sf-data-path-faq`). Enterprise page says code and context are never transmitted externally (`claim-cline-sf-data-path-enterprise`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: one open-source runtime across IDE, CLI, and SDK with BYOK (`claim-cline-sf-unique`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: agent teams, scheduling, and plugins currently not on VS Code or JetBrains (`claim-cline-sf-drawback`, `claim-cline-sf-drawback-scheduling`, `claim-cline-sf-drawback-plugins`); unspecified default sandbox (`claim-cline-sf-drawback-sandbox`); closed JetBrains plugin (`claim-cline-sf-drawback-jetbrains-closed`). Unresolved official contradictions listed below.
- Best fit: documented audiences are individual developers and enterprise teams (`claim-cline-sf-intended-user`). This is not a recommendation.
- Not-for: ClinePass is not required (`claim-cline-sf-not-for`). Native-mobile IDE status remains unknown (`claim-cline-sf-mobile-access`).
